note: Hand-seeded mutation-style faults in the bundled sample project. Each entry is a single textual substitution written as a classical mutation operator. The detection outcome of every fault is measured by execution in validation/validate_mutation.py and recorded in fault_matrix.json; nothing here asserts what a fault breaks.

faults.new_text: return sum(ai + bi for ai, bi in zip(a, b))

faults.old_text: pw * qx + px * qw + py * qz - pz * qy,
